Startup model discovery for OpenAI-compatible providers in OpenCode V2.

## Highlights

- Queries `GET <baseURL>/v1/models` once per plugin load and registers new models automatically
- Credentials: active account connection -> `settings.apiKey` -> `<PROVIDER>_API_KEY`
- Non-destructive merge: explicit capabilities, limits and costs are never overwritten
- Chat-only default filter drops video/3D/music/speech/embedding models
- `last-sync.json` status file reports per-provider results (`synced` / `skipped` / `failed`)
- Zero runtime dependencies

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ChalkCalliope/opencode-model-sync.git \\
  ~/.config/opencode/plugins/opencode-model-sync
```

OpenCode loads everything under `~/.config/opencode/plugins/` automatically - do not also register
the directory in `opencode.json`, or the plugin ID is registered twice.

Requires OpenCode v2.x (tested on v2.0.14). 26 unit tests, tsc clean.
